title: NormalizedFinding
description: A single normalized security finding produced by any scanner stage and consumed by the gate.

tool.description: The scanner that produced this finding (e.g. gitleaks, semgrep, trivy, hadolint, checkov, zap, syft).

stage.description: The pipeline stage that produced this finding.

category.description: The security category of the finding.

rule_id.description: The scanner-specific rule or check identifier.

severity.description: Normalized severity level. Must be exactly one of these four values with this exact casing.

file.description: Repo-relative path to the file containing the finding.

line.description: Line number (1-indexed). Use 0 for file-level findings.

fix.description: Human-readable remediation guidance. null if no fix is known.

id.description: Stable fingerprint: SHA-256 of 'tool|rule_id|file|line'. Set by the normalizer (gate). Used for waiver matching.

cve_id.description: CVE identifier if applicable (e.g. CVE-2023-12345). Used by P4 for SCA/container findings.

cwe.description: CWE identifier if applicable (e.g. CWE-89). Used by P4 for SAST findings.

package.description: Affected package name (for SCA/container findings). Used by P4.

installed_version.description: Currently installed version of the affected package. Used by P4.

fixed_version.description: Version in which the vulnerability is fixed. Used by P4.

fix_available.description: Whether a patched version is available. Used by P4 for prioritization.

confidence.description: Scanner confidence in this finding. Used by P4 for noise filtering.

help_uri.description: Link to rule documentation or advisory. Used by P4 in reports.

raw_severity.description: The original severity label from the tool before normalization (e.g. 'WARNING', 'CRITICAL'). Preserved for traceability.

waived.description: True if this finding has been waived by the gate. Set by the gate (P4) only, never by stages.

waiver_id.description: The waiver entry ID from security-policy.yaml that waived this finding. Set by the gate (P4) only.
